summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @onereach/pnpm-audit-junit@1.0.5 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscated script (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXXXX` identifiers, per-function dispatcher wrappers) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled, heavily obfuscated bundle (rotating string-array cipher, hex-only identifiers, char-code decoder table) that is not human-inspectable. The advertised purpose of the package is converting `pnpm audit` output to JUnit XML — a text-transformation task that has no need for a second language runtime or a bundled opaque payload. The obfuscation of both the loader (`setup.mjs`) and the payload (`math_init.js`), combined with an alternate-runtime dropper firing automatically at `npm install`, matches the install-time-rce dropper pattern: arbitrary bytes execute on the installer's host under a cover story unrelated to the package's stated function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
